entries.036272c4319c24b8: This division operates restaurants serving hand-stretched udon and Japanese cuisine under the name “Aji no Mingei.” It also supplies ingredients to franchise stores and provides management guidance. It is run by the consolidated subsidiary Aji no Mingei Food Service Co., Ltd. Revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥7,778 million, and there were 50 stores at the end of the fiscal year, including franchise stores.
entries.0437d1a9fbe4fc3e: This division operates Japanese noodle restaurants under the name “Washoku Mendokoro Sagami.” It is run by the consolidated subsidiary Sagami Restaurants Co., Ltd. Revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥28,409 million, the largest of the group’s divisions. At the end of the fiscal year, there were 166 stores.
entries.37ff102774891262: A holding company of a restaurant group that operates Washoku Mendokoro Sagami, Aji no Mingei and other restaurants.
entries.a91cc9be10ec4c1b: This division operates the self-service restaurant “Dondon-an.” It also supplies ingredients to franchise stores and provides management guidance. It is run by the consolidated subsidiary Sagami Restaurants Co., Ltd. Revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥1,024 million, and there were 28 stores at the end of the fiscal year, including franchise stores.
entries.c081b3d28ef6746a: This division operates the self-service soba restaurant “Nidaime Chosuke” and other restaurants. It also supplies ingredients to franchise stores and provides management guidance. The company and group companies operate it. Revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥2,067 million, and there were 30 stores at the end of the fiscal year, including franchise stores: 20 in Japan and 10 overseas.
entries.dc6e2c8d2ef7379b: It is the sole reportable segment of the company group. Composed of the company and seven subsidiaries, it operates restaurants and provides ingredients and management guidance to franchise (FC) stores. Revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥39,359 million, and the number of group stores at the end of the fiscal year was 274.
entries.f507b0acd5322b2a: This business provides management of subsidiaries and real estate leasing. The company and its consolidated subsidiary Sagami Management Support Co., Ltd. carry it out. Revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥79 million, from rental income on leased properties.
